title: Establish heterogeneous review rotation and acceptance latch for Search Re-ranker PRD
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: The Search Re-ranker v2 PRD introduces a lightweight on-path reranking stage that calls a dedicated smaller model for candidate scoring. This touches the serving runtime (batching/KV cache), Console telemetry, and user-exposed ranking controls. The goal of this ticket is to create a deterministic, auditable cross-team review rotation and an "acceptance latch" that defines exact signoff criteria across Engineering, Design, and Legal before the PRD is marked Ready for Implementation.
Scope: Define rotation cadence, owners, communication template, acceptance checklist, fallback lanes (if Legal requests changes), and tooling hooks (Confluence link, signoff spreadsheet, and automated GitHub label sync). Out of scope: implementing runtime changes or instrumenting telemetry (separate engineering tasks).
acceptance_criteria: PRD has a documented signoff matrix with named owners for Eng/Design/Legal/Security
All named owners have provided explicit signoff comments in Confluence or Google Doc (timestamped)
Design has uploaded final interaction spec and annotated mocks to the design drive and linked them in the PRD
Engineering has confirmed feasibility notes, performance SLO impact assessment, and a list of implementation subtasks
Legal has provided clearance on data residency and user-facing language or published open items with mitigation plan
Console and telemetry requirements are documented with dashboard links and at least one monitoring query
Signoff automation is wired: PRD page has the 'acceptance-latch' Google Sheet linked and GitHub PR template contains signoff checklist
